description: Signature-sheet scenarios replayed by supabase/tests/sql/p4_signatures through record_sign_slot / record_pass_slot / record_cancel_pass / record_remove_signature / record_resign_slot / record_transition / record_set_section_digests. Expected values come from signatures.ts (signSlot, passSlotTo, cancelPass, removeSignature, reSignSlot, startNextCycle, slotState, isSignatureStale) composed with companyStep.ts as the SQL engine composes them (see the generator header). World: company SG, vessel SG.v, SG.crew1-3, SG.master (on board), SG.admin1-2 (company actors), SG.reader (an in-window external viewer of SG.v: canWrite false, never eligible in SQL, so it is only ever refused by the write gate first, D-214). Eligibility is by namedProfileIds only. Signature ids are keyUuid("signature:<scenario>:<ref>"), profile ids keyUuid("profile:<key>"). Regenerate with node scripts/db/gen-record-fixtures.mjs; never edit by hand.

scenarios.creator: SG.crew1
scenarios.description: Later slots wait for the earlier required slot; signing in order completes the vessel side.
scenarios.name: order_and_waiting

scenarios.creator: SG.crew1
scenarios.description: Slots that share an order sign in parallel; an optional slot does not gate later slots.
scenarios.name: parallel_order_group

scenarios.creator: SG.crew1
scenarios.description: Only the named people may sign; a Master is not eligible for a slot that names someone else.
scenarios.name: eligibility_named_only

scenarios.creator: SG.crew1
scenarios.description: Re-sending the same signature id on the same slot is a no-op; reusing it elsewhere is refused.
scenarios.name: idempotent_replay_and_id_conflict

scenarios.creator: SG.crew1
scenarios.description: A login-as session can neither sign nor remove.
scenarios.name: impersonation_refused

scenarios.creator: SG.crew1
scenarios.description: Pass to an eligible person, refused for an ineligible one or a waiting / signed slot; cancel; signing clears the pass.
scenarios.name: pass_and_cancel

scenarios.creator: SG.crew1
scenarios.description: D-214: an external viewer (SG.reader, named on the slot so eligibility is not what refuses) reads the record but changes nothing: witnessing a sign, passing, cancelling a crew pass, re-signing and removing are each refused with no_write_access and the sheet unchanged; the crew still sign and remove.
scenarios.name: external_reader_changes_nothing

scenarios.creator: SG.crew1
scenarios.description: Witnessed signing: allowed slots only, a signer is required, the witness is not the signer, the signer must be eligible, visitors only where allowed; the witness alone never removes a witnessed signature, the Master does (gap/08 §B).
scenarios.name: witnessed_rules

scenarios.creator: SG.crew1
scenarios.description: D-48: on-behalf signing fails closed (method not allowed where the slot does not allow it, not eligible everywhere else).
scenarios.name: on_behalf_refused

scenarios.creator: SG.crew1
scenarios.description: distinctFrom: the creator cannot sign a creator-distinct slot, nor one person both of two distinct slots.
scenarios.name: separation_of_duties

scenarios.creator: SG.crew1
scenarios.description: Signatures are removed in reverse order, by the signer or the Master; a required removal sends later slots back to waiting and drops their passes.
scenarios.name: reverse_order_removal

scenarios.creator: SG.crew1
scenarios.description: A content change makes live signatures stale; re-sign by the same signer only, not when fresh, witnessed ones need a new ceremony; completion waits for fresh signatures.
scenarios.name: stale_and_resign

scenarios.creator: SG.crew1
scenarios.description: A slot covering one section goes stale only when that section changes.
scenarios.name: section_coverage

scenarios.creator: SG.crew1
scenarios.description: The vessel completes, the company acknowledges the cycle (D-51 lock: vessel signatures cannot be removed), signs off on the company slot; removing the company signature reopens the company step.
scenarios.name: company_sign_off_and_lock

scenarios.creator: SG.crew1
scenarios.description: D-30: the company returns the record; vessel signatures are superseded, cycle 2 starts unlocked and unsigned, the vessel signs again, the company closes.
scenarios.name: return_to_vessel_new_cycle

scenarios.creator: SG.crew1
scenarios.description: A decision kind: not approved returns it for cycle 2; approved with conditions closes it.
scenarios.name: decision_kind_not_approved

scenarios.creator: SG.crew1
scenarios.description: A stale required signature keeps the record in review when the last vessel slot signs; re-signing completes it.
scenarios.name: stale_blocks_completion

scenarios.creator: SG.crew1
scenarios.description: company_step none: the last vessel slot closes the record (closed by the vessel, not locked).
scenarios.name: no_company_step_closes

scenarios.creator: SG.crew1
scenarios.description: A company slot: only its named company people, never witnessed (a company slot cannot allow it), removed by a company actor.
scenarios.name: company_slot_rules

scenarios.creator: SG.crew1
scenarios.description: Once submitted to the company, removing a signature needs a reason (while the cycle is not acknowledged).
scenarios.name: submitted_removal_needs_reason
